authority: Owner-approved gameplay and scenario balance design. Does not establish production binding, completed tests or Warcraft client playability.

balanceRules.researchOwnership: Own completed research only; no entitlement on technology discovery or on another controller's completion
balanceRules.layers: Independent named source layers, idempotent under save/load, control changes, reconstruction, and replay. Identical contentId never multiplied by duplicate unlock sources.
balanceRules.effects: Resolve exact typed effect with condition and correct domain consumer; do not apply blanket flat health, food capacity, troop count, or money generation.
balanceRules.policies: Research unlocks selectable policy; elected rule persists under the polity. Delegate eligible policies to administrator/AI optionally, but do not silently impose controversial reforms.
balanceRules.policiesCosts: Default policy enactment requires 1% of affected provinces' annual normal tax equivalent and 90-day transition unless an effect-specific rule explicitly states otherwise; upkeep 0.5% annual tax equivalent on affected provinces. Never permit treasury below zero; failed enactment changes nothing.
balanceRules.buildingsCosts: Granary requires its normal roster/infrastructure construction materials plus 10% of owning settlement's normal annual tax equivalent, takes 90 in-game days and is max one per settlement. Rebuild after capture does not pay/award again. Captured buildings remain physically owned but benefit only eligible new controllers.
balanceRules.abilitiesCosts: Epidemic response costs 2% of settlement annual normal tax equivalent plus real medical supplies, runs 90 in-game days with a 90-day reuse cooldown; when no outbreak, cannot activate.
balanceRules.surveysCosts: Cadastral project requires 1% of provincial annual tax equivalent and 90 days of administrative work per eligible province; it persists as a local development state after completion and control changes.
balanceRules.numeric: Bonus percentages affect qualified pre-bonus domain outcome in fixed-point math, not player generic base stats; compatible distinct sources aggregate once, then apply one rounding rule at transaction/casualty boundary. No single effect creates value without existing input/resources.
balanceRules.stacking: Different compatible sources stack once by distinct typed source IDs, additions in basis points only on a common rating and not self-compounded; unrelated domains never stack. Research does not cap unbounded earned military tradition XP.
balanceRules.historicalAvailability: Research technology gates and roster/equipment availability/historical windows remain authoritative. Future discoveries do not retroactively materialize ship hulls, trained troops or construction.
balanceRules.status: All entries are design-only until the named live production consumer is executed and fresh same-revision audits confirm binding. No early release unblock.

effects.rules: Only applies where reform discussion and lawful civic institutions exist; no automatic emancipation, no blanket global diplomacy modifier
One durable granary per settlement; pays a construction bill and takes 90 campaign days; separately lowers stored grain spoilage by 10%
Reform administrative action, no double grant; +2% rural tax efficiency; temporary transition unrest only where historically applicable
Requires eligible arable land and technology; transitional unrest +5% on affected rural territory for two years; no automatic confiscation or instant manpower generation
Only eligible agricultural networks, +2% farm output conditional on locally supported farming and active organizations
90-day quarantine/medical response; reduces disease losses only; local trade throughput -10%; consumes existing medical resources and treasury; cooldown 90 days
No sword, bow, cavalry-charge or siege gain. Compatible with, but independent of, Ordered Volley/Platoon Fire damage and Pike and Shot defense
Requires actual arsenal and arms inputs, administrative upkeep +2% of artillery procurement; never spawns free guns
No benefit for isolated, unsupplied artillery; cannot manufacture ammunition from nothing
Existing market/auction infrastructure and real trade transaction required; no generated cash
Only on eligible voyages using actual weather information; no immunity, perfect prediction or generic battle armor
Purchase existing ship_of_the_line roster at its historical, shipyard, tech, manpower, funds, supply, maintenance and construction-time rules. No free hulls or automatic upgrades
Requires actual socket bayonet compatible equipment; not a generic 8% damage boost for all land forces
Reduces existing transaction/remittance costs for accessible banking networks; does not mint gold or create debt/loans
Consumes actual ore, fuel, labor and equipment; no raw-iron creation or universal wealth multiplier
Requires foundry/machining infrastructure and materials; no bonus to existing cannon combat damage
On eligible survey journeys only; does not reveal hidden map or instantly discover secrets
Requires legitimate market access and active trading volume; real counterparty and stock constraints remain
Must complete paid local survey before benefit, no instant census of unknown territory; collected revenue still limited by taxable economic capacity
Only active scholarly centers with research inputs; no direct firearm or artillery firepower
Consumes and transports real grain; reduces waste, not hunger when disconnected from logistics
Only actual built and usable canal routes; not desert roads, ocean passages or generic player movement
Reduces financing costs for real canal works; does not hand out free capital or apply to all buildings
Actual repair materials, money, access and time required; no healing at sea, no free owned docks
Only valid carronade mounts and close-range cannon shots; no free armament and no long-range buff; preserve gunnery doctrine and vessel refit layers
Only ships with historically compatible carvel construction/refit; no automatic redesign of legacy hulls or combat invulnerability
